notes: The prompt self-declares as an arena shooter and the combat is ranged fire at waves of enemy tanks, so Shooter leads; Action owns the word arena in the index but this is not a melee clash space, so I did not name it second. Shape is space-bounded, taken from the catalogue rather than Shooter's typical list, because a tight 300-stud box arena driven around freely is one clearly bounded single-level space - lane-network and open-battlefield both say the opposite of what the answers gave, one by imposing lanes and the other by being large and dispersed. I started from the PvE Shooter preset for the wave loop and kept spawner-npc as the readable edges the tank waves enter from, but its lane map, chokepoints and breachable interiors are all contradicted by an open box, and with the shape swapped and most options gone the preset is no longer recognisable, so it is emitted as none. Decided without a user: the arena is endless with a score, so nothing terminates the run and no finish or capture zone was placed, and I added no cover arrays since the answers describe open ground; the chase camera, crosshair and radar are all HUD and camera work with no layout consequence, which keeps this on P0.
